set_pieces.name: The reading
set_pieces.line: What we've made we don't want, what we've sold to the world, to ourselves, doesn't exist.

set_pieces.name: Haze at the window
set_pieces.line: I look for a way out through the hallways, within the drawers and fire escapes, trip on my own words, falling out of life, and find where you go when you leave.

set_pieces.name: Off the fire escape
set_pieces.line: It was the maze constructed by a tainted love, a known yet unknown pit beneath the quicksands of the make-believe haven, and hidden in the overnourished forest of escapism that calls

set_pieces.name: The fall montage
set_pieces.line: for you. At this age, I'll follow, following the full distance between us almost having it all and

set_pieces.name: Crashing the vintage party
set_pieces.line: starting anew, to rediscover when love was real. I failed at protecting you from your own vices, crashing the party of your evilest instincts

set_pieces.name: Hole in the floor
set_pieces.line: to find vibrations that echo in silence, love and hate languages that translate and slow

poems.title: Flashing Lights
poems.note: The Childhood Window on the Road Winding Down

set_pieces.name: Falling with headlights off
set_pieces.line: I heard a scream for help while falling with my headlights off.

set_pieces.name: Eyes dilate
set_pieces.line: It was a type of silent scream a trap lover makes to escape a pending marriage, a concussion, a set of walls caving inward, seething and simmering,

set_pieces.name: Car pulls up
set_pieces.line: and a solitude of crowds and smiles. I received an emergency call while tossing and turning.

set_pieces.name: The ghost child
set_pieces.line: It was a type of silent call a man makes to the mirror after midnight.

set_pieces.name: Parents arguing in the car
set_pieces.line: To digest the truth, a windless insomnia and epiphany of a road winding down.

set_pieces.name: Tambourine through the window
set_pieces.line: After a day of life dilated at the sun as long and as wise as possible, we won't make it.

poems.title: How to break off an engagement

set_pieces.name: Tambourine through the chapel window
set_pieces.line: Old to forever, a tambourine sounds off an empty temple, empty choir stands, empty prayer lines, and abandoned Baptist pools,

set_pieces.name: The empty temple
set_pieces.line: pews taken by cobwebs, and doused in disintegration.

set_pieces.name: Gifts at the side doors
set_pieces.line: Spirits have left salvations and opened gift boxes placed outside the side doors.

set_pieces.name: The storm
set_pieces.line: It thunders, then it rains until nothing remains.

set_pieces.name: Remnants on the shore
set_pieces.line: Old to the storm ending, what was once love now goods, broken and sealed apart by lightning,

set_pieces.name: Tambourine shatters
set_pieces.line: daily breads soaked and delivered rotted by rain, and blankets soiled by venomous puppeteers,

poems.title: Nevermore
poems.note: Ruins Shore and the Night Garden Fields

set_pieces.name: Shore of broken pieces
set_pieces.line: What if I follow this trail to where the broken pieces have washed ashore and the ashes of expired wildfires

set_pieces.name: The silence
set_pieces.line: cover sands and debris lift it from the night seawater's floor.

set_pieces.name: The heart on the sand
set_pieces.line: The waves will calm to fold it whispers and the winds will mute the trees for the right level of silence

set_pieces.name: Trail up the incline
set_pieces.line: to find a throbbing heart left at the midlife corner returned toward the incline.

set_pieces.name: Night garden field
set_pieces.line: A familiar heart which has shaken off every sad blue note life can perform to overcome and spread inspiration

set_pieces.name: Searching for hands
set_pieces.line: and it used to be mine. I'll lift it with care putting it back in place and tell myself nevermore.

set_pieces.name: The field goes still
set_pieces.line: They tell me to ask if I can inherit the earth, to ask if I can name my own stars, even galaxies if I may.

set_pieces.name: Naming stars
set_pieces.line: The past too was waiting for me. Coming of age in the shared rooms of human basements as bedrooms, mattress pads where the wood beams

set_pieces.name: Southern-pine basement (memory)
set_pieces.line: of southern pine could comfort my spine, it didn't.

set_pieces.name: Universes and blessings
set_pieces.line: To dream was to prevail. They tell me to ask if I can invent a new universe,

set_pieces.name: Blood through the hands
set_pieces.line: to ask if God would let me, little old me, award a blessing here or there.

set_pieces.name: Baritone and warning
set_pieces.line: Even grant miracles where the needs of the spoken word exists. In uncertain times, in forsaken times,

set_pieces.name: The Light Gates open
set_pieces.line: The gates open with wings gifted from evolution, and made of marble stones kissed by the hymns our creator composed with an orchestra of our ancestors wildest dreams to

set_pieces.name: Road down, following comets
set_pieces.line: welcome us. Poets who eased generations down yellow brick roads and plucked our souls out

set_pieces.name: The city rises / here we are all one
set_pieces.line: of their secret places to follow comets to the capital city of our collective consciousness, resurrecting Atlantis. Here we are all one. The pack we've made here with nature

set_pieces.name: Jungle Interface and the heart-scan admission
set_pieces.line: abandon and hope for the best back on life. A relearned currency we reassess as a mission,

set_pieces.name: City Center: all safe
set_pieces.line: but here we are all safe. Here we are all one. The pack we've made here with nature

set_pieces.name: Narrow streets by candlelight
set_pieces.line: abandon and hope for the best back on life. A relearned currency we reassess as a mission,

set_pieces.name: DJ drops in
set_pieces.line: DJ turn me up please. With eyes wide shut and my chin nested at the arc of the weight of these

set_pieces.name: Eyes wide shut at the mic
set_pieces.line: spoken words, I have a story to tell. Of ghosts whispering unfolded delusions, birthed in purity

set_pieces.name: Ghosts in the speaker mesh
set_pieces.line: and dying and the veneers of sun-soaked evergreen fields are nourished. A love story of one by one

set_pieces.name: A thousand light years, into the red
set_pieces.line: treasures escaping and devaluing themselves after defamed unsalted stars diminish their glares.

set_pieces.name: Wedding bands and the boxed home
set_pieces.line: And I've walked a thousand light years across the greatest divide to be heard. So DJ please turn me

set_pieces.name: Eleven years in daisy petals
set_pieces.line: up. So I can speak of wedding bands diverging across abstract skies of wounded souls. Of a

poems.title: Newly Single
poems.note: Dance & Self — the open-air rooftop club over Atlantis

set_pieces.name: The soul leaves the dancer
set_pieces.line: The soul has escaped my body for the moment and left him on the dance floor. He can now just be flesh and bones, rejection and heartache hit differently when there are no feelings afloat.

set_pieces.name: Strangers collide; the last one to leave
set_pieces.line: I want my soul now to imagine my body pulsing and head throbbing from the music and empty on

set_pieces.name: Soul over Atlantis / the open field at the equator
set_pieces.line: a crowded floor of sweated perfumes and temptations. Let's watch strangers collide and spark electric

set_pieces.name: Angels' ice-water baptism
set_pieces.line: currents that gamut the mood, a good one. We want him to be the last one to leave, prolonging the

set_pieces.name: Haze and the soul's return
set_pieces.line: bitter refraction inside the walls of an escape that few pleasures offer us. Now let us put my

set_pieces.name: Mountains from the rooftop
set_pieces.line: soul in the middle of an open field at the equator of a planet much larger than my own and much hotter. Cool me down by pouring unfiltered water out of the ice bath salted from the closest

poems.title: Yet, Heard
poems.note: The phone-booth sidewalk below the club, Atlantis

set_pieces.name: The EX in the crowd
set_pieces.line: Accepting you'll never say nor ever feel, my love was real.

set_pieces.name: Walking toward the moon
set_pieces.line: What isn't mine I still cannot give. I gather my things to go.

set_pieces.name: Suitcases at the phone booth
set_pieces.line: Before I go, we look at the moon the way we used to see it and settle down the stillnessism.

set_pieces.name: The call to Mother
set_pieces.line: We talk for years and travel through time and it feels so good.

set_pieces.name: Father and son to the inner harbor
set_pieces.line: We grow old together. I believe maybe we could have it all, or swing in my humbled late nights and heartbreaks

set_pieces.name: The EX turns to haze
set_pieces.line: and an end story unchanging. You help me gather my things to go.

poems.title: Magic Ride
poems.note: Highway Journey Realm — Atlantis city streets out through the mountain pass

set_pieces.name: The bike under the street lamp
set_pieces.line: I wasn't looking for a ride, but here you are, blissful and oddly sensitive,

set_pieces.name: Mounting the machine
set_pieces.line: withering a soul purveying both the dark and the light worlds I've known.

set_pieces.name: Loneliness through midnight intersections
set_pieces.line: So I rub my aggressions into your steel coverings and hop on to amuse myself.

set_pieces.name: Swagger down the avenue
set_pieces.line: Loneliness is having everything with no one to tell, being everywhere with no one to love and escape,

set_pieces.name: Out of Atlantis as the moon settles
set_pieces.line: wide-eyed and stone but alive and well, wandering with no clear end.

set_pieces.name: Mountain road at first light
set_pieces.line: I let the noise block the noise so the way I ride through the streets with the swag and eyes turn, has twists, improve, yeah, the magic still exists.

poems.title: New Day
poems.note: The New Temple at Chapel Shore

set_pieces.name: Arrival on the chilly shore
set_pieces.line: Even here is chilly in the morning. River rafting fall covers the seas in the distance

set_pieces.name: Choir chords in the new nave (inferred)
set_pieces.line: and hugs the bases of tree-covered hills. This world is at peace.

set_pieces.name: Remnants in the sunlight
set_pieces.line: In silent resounds, choir chords calm the nerves of things I can't control and offer them as keepsakes back to the higher powers.

set_pieces.name: The temple builds itself
set_pieces.line: Exhausted emotions carry forward a diminishing flame to emit jazz tuned lyrics that heat and dry the morning dew.

set_pieces.name: Journal and the lonely mirror (inferred)
set_pieces.line: All the remnants of the destruction revealed in the sunlight. We can rebuild this temple.

set_pieces.name: Welcoming the new day
set_pieces.line: It's a new day. The catharsis evoked by loss in the painful crawl

poems.title: Reunion
poems.note: Main Hall of the New Temple

set_pieces.name: Welcome home in the hall
set_pieces.line: Decades later, there was less time for words and more space for laughter, hugs with no reason,

set_pieces.name: Loud voices, overheard hearts
set_pieces.line: loud voices so our hearts can be overheard. My mind drifts into the darkness of our afterlives,

set_pieces.name: The empty rooms of the afterlife
set_pieces.line: and those rooms are empty. We are all here, each holding our glasses of burning sands

set_pieces.name: Hourglasses and the group photo (archival reenactment)
set_pieces.line: and known journeys, and grateful to every living tree in the forest for the shared years and the shared memories. This is brotherhood. Smiles with no reason,

set_pieces.name: Trees at the forest edge
set_pieces.line: narrow differences so our hearts can be overheard. Decades later, we can place our ears upon the next

set_pieces.name: Brotherhood chain
set_pieces.line: brother's soul and follow paths of hilltops and canyons, of blinding lights and infinite nights,

poems.title: How to Win My Heart
poems.note: Corner Cafe at the Harbor of the Heavens

set_pieces.name: The corner cafe table
set_pieces.line: I want you to notice me in a corner cafe at the Harbor of the Heavens, wandering in thought,

set_pieces.name: Walk from the temple around the harbor
set_pieces.line: discovering water on Jupiter's moons, healing the sick with silent prayers and molding a better world to return to

set_pieces.name: Distances, younger selves, praying elders
set_pieces.line: with every pulsing beat after walking alone. I want you to really notice me

set_pieces.name: Victory-less seasons (inner montage)
set_pieces.line: with the distances we couldn't avoid and our younger selves watching and dreaming, while our elders clutch their pearls,

set_pieces.name: Harvesting the poppies
set_pieces.line: hold their faith and breath closely, freeing their worries peacefully.

set_pieces.name: From a distant window
set_pieces.line: I've journeyed beyond any place you can conceivably be. So I thought, life has burned all of my love stories.
